interface.description: Network interface the server binds to for DHCPv6 traffic.

listen_address.description: Multicast or unicast IPv6 address to listen on (e.g., link-local FF02::1:2 for DHCPv6 server discovery).

port.description: UDP port to listen on (standard DHCPv6 port: 546).

syslog.description: Enable logging to the system syslog daemon.

max_requests.description: Maximum concurrent DHCP requests to handle; 0 means unlimited.

config_dir.description: Directory containing per-client configuration files (e.g., hostname, static assignments).

mac_lookup.description: Enable lookup of client identity from MAC address (used for MAC-aware classification).

ldap_url.description: LDAP URI to query MAC-to-identity mappings; leave empty to disable LDAP.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as when connecting to LDAP (required if LDAP is enabled and anonymous binds disallowed).

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind; prefer using `ldap_bind_secret_file` instead.

ldap_bind_secret_file.description: Path to a file containing the LDAP bind password (must be readable only by dhcpy6d user).

ldap_mac_attr.description: LDAP attribute name containing MAC addresses (e.g., 'macAddress' or 'dhcpClientIdentifier').

default_lease_time.description: Default lease duration in seconds for assigned IPv6 addresses.

max_lease_time.description: Maximum lease duration allowed (clients cannot request longer).

dns_servers.description: List of IPv6 DNS servers to advertise to clients.

domain_search.description: List of DNS domain search suffixes to advertise.

ntp_servers.description: Optional list of NTP servers to advertise (IPv6 addresses).

name.description: Human-readable name for this address pool.

prefix.description: IPv6 prefix (CIDR notation) for this pool, e.g., '2001:db8:1::/64'.

start.description: First IPv6 address in the usable range (inclusive), e.g., '2001:db8:1::10'.

end.description: Last IPv6 address in the usable range (inclusive), e.g., '2001:db8:1::ff'.

static_reservations.description: Map of MAC addresses (colon-separated, lowercase) to static IPv6 addresses for reserved clients.

pools.description: List of IPv6 address pools to serve. Each pool defines a range and optional static reservations.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

log_file.description: Path to the primary log file; empty string disables file logging.

db_dsn.description: Database DSN for persistent lease storage (e.g., 'sqlite:////var/lib/dhcpy6d/dhcpy6d.db'); empty = in-memory only.
